description: This file demonstrates usage of Timer and Compare APIs for benchmarking sparse matrix operations in PyTorch, including class definitions, data generation, and benchmarking execution.

classes.name: FauxTorch
classes.description: A class to emulate different versions of PyTorch for benchmarking purposes.

classes.name: FauxTorch.Sparse
classes.description: A nested class within FauxTorch to emulate sparse tensor operations.

methods.name: generate_coo_data
methods.description: Generates COO format sparse tensor data (indices and values).

methods.name: gen_sparse
methods.description: Creates a sparse COO tensor with specified size, density, dtype, and device.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function executing benchmarking tasks and comparisons.
